name: Tivit, Seller of Secrets
blocked_sentences: Council's dilemma — Whenever Tivit enters or deals combat damage to a player, starting with you, each player votes for evidence or bribery. For each evidence vote, investigate. For each bribery vote, create a Treasure token
While voting, you may vote an additional time

needs.what: a voting op: starting with the controller and proceeding in turn order, each player publicly votes for one of N named options (here 'evidence' or 'bribery'); the op binds the tally per option (e.g. as: 'votes' giving {binding: 'votes.evidence'} / {binding: 'votes.bribery'}) so later effects in the same ability can use each count as an amount -- here investigate with amount = evidence votes and create_token treasure_token with amount = bribery votes. Each vote must be visible to the players voting after them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode is one chooser picking modes, not every player casting a public vote with a per-option tally; for_each_player + choose_mode cannot accumulate a count per chosen option into a value, and value_keys has no vote count. The trigger (self_enters / deals_combat_damage_to_player), investigate, the Treasure token and the flying/ward {3} line are all expressible; only the vote is missing

needs.what: a player-wide static (affects_player: 'you') that gives its controller one additional vote, cast as a separate vote that may be for the same or a different option, whenever that player votes -- read by the council_s_dilemma / will-of-the-council voting op, including the vote this same card's trigger starts
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No static_effect adds votes, and with no voting op there is nothing for it to modify; join_forces and choose_player are not votes
